_doc: Reviewed extraction of CPCB's 'Polluted River Stretches for Restoration of Water Quality' (October 2025, updated version) for the states the Atlas covers. Stretches from Annexure III A and single-location PRS from Annexure III B, each with its monitoring stations (Annexure III B, XIV) and its 2018-to-2025 change class (Annexures IX to XIII). The district list per entry is the only judgement here: 'named' districts come from place names CPCB prints, 'course' districts from the maintainer's reading of the river's course, and every district carries its basis. scripts/atlas-polluted-stretches.ts serves each district's entries; the PDF is not mirrored (CPCB terms), so serials and PDF pages are the citation.
